issues.description: The problem statement contains a conflicting return type for getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the task description (lines 44-45) says it should return a String formatted as "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", but the UML diagram (lines 70-71) declares the method as returning void. The solution implements and tests a String-returning method. This inconsistency in the specification can confuse students about the correct method signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in the problem statement to declare getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String to match the textual description and the solution implementation (or alternatively change the textual description to match the UML). Ensure all references (UML, task text, and any tests) consistently specify the method as returning String.
